notes.zh: Camera-WaterMark 3.0：全新界面与主题系统；离线 EXIF 读取，导入即显示文字水印；修复放大后拖拽平移；图片/模糊卡片水印、批量全分辨率导出；新增检查更新；Windows 与 Android 版本。
notes.en: Camera-WaterMark 3.0: redesigned UI and themes; offline EXIF so text watermark shows right after import; fixed pan after zoom; logo / blur-card watermarks, full-res batch export; update check; Windows and Android builds.
